item.title: Five Checks Before Choosing an AI Interview Copilot
item.summary: “Real-time” sounds like a single feature, but it is really a chain of decisions. The software must work with the candidate’s computer, hear or see the right input, interpret the question, show a useful cue quickly, and stay out of the way while the candidate speaks.
